name: marimo
tagline: A reactive Python notebook with a web interface and application deployment tools.
hook: Frames agent work around all project users and maintainers, then makes human-directed contribution and disclosure rules explicit.
summary: marimo opens with a statement of whom an agent should serve when contributing to a public library. The rest of the file pairs Python and frontend checks with contribution requirements and a docstring convention that automated formatting may not catch.

techniques.title: Expand the audience beyond the immediate requester
techniques.body: The opening frames APIs, abstractions, documentation, and code as the product. It asks the agent to consider existing and future users as well as the person requesting a patch.
techniques.quote: Being an open source library, the public API, abstractions, documentation, and the code itself are the product and deserve careful consideration.

techniques.title: Put human direction before PR creation
techniques.body: The PR section explicitly requires a human request before submission. The file presents contribution authority as a separate constraint from the ability to produce code.
techniques.quote: - DO NOT open a pull request autonomously, without explicit instructions from a human

techniques.title: Provide exact disclosure wording
techniques.body: The guide gives the location and full text of the agent-authorship notice and also requires a draft. This removes ambiguity about how a contributor should disclose the origin of a patch.
techniques.quote: - You MUST disclose that you are an agent at the very top of your PR description: "**This pull request was authored by a coding agent.**"

techniques.title: Reserve prose guidance for a linting gap
techniques.body: The Python conventions section says most rules already live in tooling. Its additional instruction concerns the Markdown dialect used by rendered docstrings, including the exact inline-code delimiter.
techniques.quote:
- Docstrings are rendered as Markdown, not reStructuredText. Use single
  backticks for inline code (`value`), never double backticks.

steal: Describe the long-term audience for a contribution.
State whether a human must initiate public submissions.
Supply exact wording when attribution must be consistent.
Keep prose style rules focused on gaps in automated checks.
outline: Your primary responsibility is to the project and its users
